question: Should OpenClaw add a native ASR/STT backend abstraction for platform voice input, and which initial platform flow plus security contract should it support?
rationale: The request is valid but cannot safely be reduced to one settings URL because maintainers must choose native app versus Gateway/media ownership, endpoint/auth handling, private-network policy, and fallback behavior before implementation.

options.title: Design native STT seam first
options.body: Add a maintainer-scoped native ASR/STT abstraction, start with the smallest approved flow, and reuse tools.media.audio or provider contracts where that is the chosen owner boundary.

options.title: Route only through existing provider surfaces
options.body: Narrow or close core native work if maintainers decide existing media, Talk transcription, provider plugin, and ClawHub surfaces are the supported integration path.

options.title: Defer custom endpoints
options.body: Keep Apple/Android platform speech as the only native voice input path until the security and UX requirements are clearer.

recommendation.title: Design native STT seam first
recommendation.body: Add a maintainer-scoped native ASR/STT abstraction, start with the smallest approved flow, and reuse tools.media.audio or provider contracts where that is the chosen owner boundary.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter Steinberger has the strongest sampled native Talk/voice feature-history signal and is already mentioned on this issue timeline.
